You will drive innovation, define architectural standards, and provide expert guidance to ensure optimal data protection, availability, and cost-effectiveness. Job Responsibilities Lead the design and architecture of enterprise-level backup and storage solutions, encompassing on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Evaluate and recommend new backup and storage technologies, platforms, and vendors to meet evolving business needs and industry best practices. Develop and maintain architectural roadmaps, standards, policies, and guidelines for backup and storage systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including infrastructure, applications, security, and operations, to integrate backup and storage solutions seamlessly. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers and administrators within the backup and storage domain. Conduct performance analysis, capacity planning, and troubleshooting for complex backup and storage issues. Ensure compliance with data retention policies, disaster recovery objectives, and regulatory requirements. Drive continuous improvement initiatives for backup and storage processes, automation, and efficiency. Manage vendor relationships and engage in technical discussions to influence product roadmaps and support. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all backup and storage architectures and configurations. Job Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. 10+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure with a strong focus on backup and storage technologies. Proven experience as an architect or lead engineer designing and implementing large-scale enterprise backup and storage solutions. Deep expertise in various backup technologies (e.g., Commvault) and their underlying architectures. Extensive knowledge of storage area networks (SAN), network-attached storage (NAS), object storage (e.g., S3). Strong understanding of cloud storage services (AWS S3, Azure Blob) and cloud-native backup strategies. Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., PowerShell) for managing and orchestrating backup and storage operations. Familiarity with disaster recovery planning, business continuity, and data replication strategies. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Commvault Certified Engineer, VCP-DCV, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly desirable. review_candidates.title: Senior Technology Operations / Support Specialist - Onsite
review_candidates.description: Summary Our nationwide Financial Services customer is seeking a full-time, onsite Desktop Support & Technology Engineer to support and maintain business-critical applications, integrations, and enterprise technology systems. The role focuses on application support, production troubleshooting, system monitoring, security administration, and end-user technical support, while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process improvements. The ideal candidate is a strong problem solver and communicator who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams in a fast-paced environment. Experience with mortgage-related applications or business processes is a plus but not required. Location: Newport Beach, CA (Onsite) Duties and Responsibilities Provide application support for business-critical systems, including troubleshooting incidents, analyzing root causes, and coordinating timely resolution. Monitor application health, system interfaces, scheduled jobs, and data flows to ensure reliable performance and issue prevention. Investigate, diagnose, and resolve application errors, data issues, and process failures across integrated systems. Support mortgage-related applications and operational workflows when applicable, including issue triage, user support, and coordination with technical teams. Troubleshoot, configure, and support Encompass add-ons and related integrations to ensure stable operation and effective user support. Work with internal teams and third-party vendors to troubleshoot issues, coordinate fixes, support system changes, and ensure timely resolution of production and application-related problems. Support application deployments, release validation, hotfix implementation, and post-release monitoring. Push reports and related updates to production environments in accordance with established release and change management procedures. Provide first-level to intermediate support for desktops, printers, laptops, monitors, and other end-user hardware, including setup, troubleshooting, and replacement coordination. Troubleshoot hardware, connectivity, peripheral, and workstation issues to minimize downtime and maintain user productivity. Install, configure, and support standard desktop software, printers, and peripheral devices in alignment with company procedures. Coordinate new hire equipment onboarding, including preparing, configuring, and issuing laptops, monitors, peripherals, and required software access. Serve as the Security Officer for assigned technology and operational responsibilities, including managing user access, adding and removing users, helping enforce security practices, and coordinating security-related activities. Support termination-related security processes, including deprovisioning access, retrieving company equipment, and coordinating with relevant teams to ensure proper closure. Maintain and update business continuity and disaster recovery (BCP/DR) plans to support operational readiness and recovery objectives. Prepare and provide data, documentation, and support materials for quarterly IT audit activities. Document support procedures, known issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolution outcomes to improve operational efficiency and knowledge sharing. Communicate clearly with business users and technical teams regarding issue status, system impacts, and recommended solutions. Quickly build understanding of new applications, business processes, and subject areas while maintaining strong service and support standards. Provide after-hours or on-call support as needed for critical incidents, deployments, or business operations. Qualifications and Requirements 3 years+ of experience in application support, production support, systems support, desktop support, or a related technical role. Working knowledge of SQL, including basic query writing and data analysis for troubleshooting. Experience supporting business applications, interfaces, batch jobs, reports, desktops, printers, and other end-user hardware in a production environment. Basic knowledge of Windows desktop environments, device setup, printer support, peripheral troubleshooting, and production support processes. Experience supporting report deployments, production releases, or change management activities is preferred. Experience preparing data or documentation for audit, compliance, or review activities is a plus. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong documentation skills and the ability to create support procedures, incident summaries, and process documentation. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and external vendors. Quick learner who can adapt to new systems, business processes, hardware environments, and changing priorities. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Willingness to work flexible hours or participate in on-call support, if required.
